pages.title: Arthur Mourgue: research engineer, robotics and AI
pages.description: Research engineer in robotics and AI. I work on AI for robots, from training the models to making them work on real hardware. Building LaMain, an open-source robot hand with touch. Looking for an end-of-studies internship from March 2027.

pages.title: LaMain · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: LaMain: an open-source three-finger robot hand with touch for the SO-101 arm. 5 DOF, under 200 g (target), under €200 (target), with tactile sensors and LeRobot integration.
pages.og_description: An open-source three-finger robot hand with touch for the SO-101 arm.

pages.title: LePotager · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: LePotager: a robot arm that sorts fruit by pressing it, using imitation learning on vision and touch. Built in 48 hours at the LeRobot hackathon in Copenhagen.
pages.og_description: A robot arm that sorts fruit by touch, built in 48 hours at the LeRobot hackathon.

pages.title: Capra Robotics · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: Capra Robotics: three problems on real autonomous mobile robots. Ground segmentation on a Jetson, anonymisation inside an OAK-D camera, and LiDAR docking to a food cart.
pages.og_description: Three problems on real autonomous mobile robots, from computer vision to LiDAR docking.

pages.title: DagoBERT · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: DagoBERT: a local language model that turns plain English into embedded C++ for ARM flight-test hardware, co-authored as a paper at ETTC 2025.
pages.og_description: A local language model that turns plain English into embedded C++ for ARM flight-test hardware.
